message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has sent the email proposing the meeting time. As I feared, he has no way of seeing any replies. He suggests monitoring their calendars for changes. I can see the calendars for Priya and Marcus, but not for Elena and David.

This means I can't see if Elena's calendar changes. Brad is the only one who can see Elena's calendar. So, the responsibility is on him to monitor her calendar.

I'll write a message to Brad telling him that I can't see Elena's calendar and that he needs to be the one to monitor it for changes. I'll ask him to let me know as soon as he sees that her 10:00 AM slot on Thursday is free. I will then book the meeting.

I will also check Priya's and Marcus's calendars again, just in case something has changed on their end. It's unlikely, but it's good to be thorough.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: append_workspace
function.arguments:
{"text":"Thanks for sending the email, Brad.

You've highlighted the key problem: we need to know if Elena can reschedule. As you know, I can't see Elena's calendar. You are the only one who can.

Could you please monitor Elena Soto's calendar? As soon as you see that her "Hiring panel" on Thursday at 10:00 AM is moved and the slot is free, please let me know in the workspace.

Once I get your confirmation that she is free, I will immediately book the meeting for Thursday at 10:00 AM. After that, you can send the official confirmation email.

I'll be on standby, ready to create the booking as soon as I hear from you."}
